text: Which repositories hold E. coli AMR datasets?

summary.question: Which repositories hold E. coli AMR datasets?
summary.answer:
SRA reported 39,786 total runs with 50 retrieved; NDE reported 5,424 total datasets with 50 retrieved. SRA and NDE searches were capped at 50 returned records from total counts of 39,786 and 5,424 respectively, providing representative but not comprehensive catalogs.

| Source | Total | Retrieved | Record Types |
|---|---|---|---|
| GEO | 18 | 18 | Series |
| NDE | 5,424 | 50 | Dataset |
| SRA | 39,786 | 50 | Runs |
